front.title: Reporting the Availability of Referenced Software and Model Repositories

abstract.t: Papers, catalogues, model cards and tool lists point to code and model repositories by URL. Such repositories can be deleted, made private, blocked or simply stop changing, and reports of "link rot" or "project survival" often mix these different events into one number. This document defines how to classify each observation of a referenced repository, when a repository counts as unavailable, how to report inactivity separately from unavailability, and a small JSON report object. It also recommends citing a persistent identifier or an archived copy next to the repository URL.
